sections.h: Why strength training matters more after 50
p: Muscle and bone don't take care of themselves as we age. Without training, strength gradually slips away, and everyday things like carrying groceries, climbing stairs or getting up off the floor start to feel harder.
The good news: your body still responds to strength training at every age. With the right coaching, women in their 50s, 60s and 70s build real, noticeable strength.

sections.h: What training looks like at Alloy Personal Training Buckhead

Every exercise adjusted to your fitness level and history

p: Many of our members started with zero lifting experience. Your coach starts where you are, teaches you good form, and progresses you safely week by week. No intimidation, no guesswork.

faq.q: Is it too late to start strength training after 50?
faq.a: No. Muscles respond to training at every age. The key is starting at the right level and progressing gradually with good coaching.
No. Your coach adjusts every exercise to your current fitness level and teaches you proper form from day one.

sections.h: Train for the life you want to keep living
p: Strength is what lets you get up from a low chair, carry your grandkids, travel comfortably and catch yourself if you trip. Training for it is one of the best investments you can make in staying independent.
Our coaches focus on the movements you use every day — standing up, bending, lifting, carrying and stepping — so the strength you build shows up in real life.

faq.q: Is strength training safe for older adults?
faq.a: With proper coaching and the right starting level, strength training is a great fit for most older adults. Talk with your doctor before starting any new exercise program, especially if you have a medical condition.

faq.q: What if I have an old injury or limitation?
faq.a: Tell your coach at your intro session. Exercises are adjusted to your history so you can train around limitations.
Two to three sessions a week is a great target for most people.

p: A big-box gym gives you equipment but no guidance. One-on-one training gives you guidance at a premium price. Small-group personal training at Alloy Personal Training Buckhead sits in between: personal coaching, a motivating group, and a schedule that fits real life.
